title: Characterizing False Negatives in Standard Alignment Evaluation Suites

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Extremely clear chain: if standard evaluation suites have high false-negative rates for known misalignment, safety certifications based on them are unreliable. This is foundational to the entire evaluation-based safety paradigm.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Using existing emergent misalignment induction (insecure-code), running standard benchmarks (TruthfulQA, BBQ), and a custom probe suite. The custom probe design requires creativity but the tooling exists. Medium compute suffices.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single model with known induced misalignment, two evaluation conditions (standard suite vs. custom probes), one metric (false-negative rate). Clear, tight deliverable achievable in 30 hours.
